correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified end-to-end. Re-ran both artifacts: polarized Fujiki gives int e a^3=3q(a)q(e,a) and int e a^2b=q(a)q(e,b)+2q(a,e)q(a,b); wall F=q(a)q(e,b)-2q(a,b)q(e,a) with G(s)/4=t0 s^2-4s+2t0, G(0)>0>G(t0), transverse root s*=2k-sqrt(4k^2-2) in (0,t0) irrational via consecutive-squares argument, s_big outside cone. Ampleness via HC pullback nef + (-E) relatively ample + nef/ample convex combo is sound. E violates even semistability below s* while (b,b) has LHS=m<=3=4-1 for all Z, so verdict flips inside ample cone; no integral e'^perp meets P at irrational s* since q(e',a)=D'.Hs+2ys gives rational s. ADMISSION_DEFECT not applicable: failure is structural, not cheap type/vacuity/small-instance artifact.

value.rationale: TARGET-route rigorous disproof of an ambitious two-sided wall-crossing criterion is independently valuable: it blocks a false structural identification (J-walls = MBM walls), salvages a correct one-sided divisorial slope formula F=0 (quadric), and gives an explicit infinite family (quartic S^[2], all large k) with interior irrational wall. This is not a normalization error, vacuity, tiny-instance mismatch, lookup, or arbitrary-parameter fact; general-n check shows phenomenon persists. Future work on J-equation on IHS must account for nonlinear interior walls.
